verdict.rationale: Gemini docs explicitly describe scheduling recurring actions to run automatically as part of daily/weekly/monthly routines, and Gemini Apps can connect to other apps to take actions autonomously (e.g., editing content, creating calendar events) with permission. This directly supports background automations, though evidence lacks detail on triggers, monitoring, or independent hands-on verification of these scheduled tasks running reliably. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of scheduled automations working reliably, more detail on trigger conditions and failure handling.
